title: Reap activity guard Chrome children and remove disposable profiles
outcome: The activity-indicator browser guard waits for owned Chrome children to exit and releases its own disposable profiles while preserving useful diagnostic evidence.
acceptance: Normal and failure paths await the owned browser child exit with bounded hang handling, then attempt cleanup only of resolved profile paths inside this run's repository-local scratch root.
JSON/PNG/log evidence remains available; cleanup failures identify retained owned profiles and never delete another run's files.
Command documentation distinguishes visible stepped timelines, paused offscreen motion and static transcript/strip, and states runtime prerequisites accurately.
